slice: RF-1086 staged observation-only withdrawal database foundation
scopeProvenance: Bounded RF-only engineering slice authorized in parent-agent assignment; no human acceptance, launch or runtime activation decision.

behavior.storage: Immutable FORCE-RLS RF-owned register_observation_withdrawals; exact target composite FK, unique target and actor/company/year/key, retained original receipt and historical actor identity.
behavior.commitments: Typed SQL append accepts scope, target, exact reason and key only. SQL creates UUID/time/canonical UTF-8 JSON and both domain-separated SHA-256 commitments. Table CHECKs rebuild exact receipt from every row binding and compare both stored hashes; no caller receipt or hash is trusted.
behavior.authority: Verified actor/current accepted owner checked before and after company lock, then established RF company/year lock. No commercial or current company-year gate is required for withdrawal. Fresh target must be exact, unsuperseded and unwithdrawn; time cannot predate capture.
behavior.replay: Actor/company/year/key lookup compares exact original request before fresh-head validation; exact replay returns original bytes, mismatch conflicts, other actors cannot recover another actor's receipt.
oldEntryBackstops: append_register_observation_v1: correction predecessor must remain active after company/year locking
assert_current_register_observation_v1: exact requested observation must remain active after company locking
behavior.isolation: The private active predicate requires READ COMMITTED so an old correction cannot use a pre-withdrawal REPEATABLE READ snapshot after waiting. Historical reads and capture-receipt lookup remain unchanged.
behavior.grantState: No EXECUTE grant to PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role, shareholder_register_filing_executor or corporate_governance_workflow_executor for the new append or private canonical/active helpers. No direct runtime table mutation. Tests use one unique NOLOGIN/NOBYPASSRLS fixture role with exact cleanup.
behavior.rollback: Retained rows abort rollback atomically. Empty rollback leaves inert storage/guards and closed runtime grant intact; it does not remove invalidation checks. Existing full-schema teardown already refuses retained target observations.
behavior.overlap: Only two old observation entry points are guarded, preserving their OIDs, signatures, ownership and ACLs. Successor registry reapplication restores these guards after historical migrations replay. No persistence port, adapter, HTTP route or command activation is added.

limits: Evidence is bound to these local source hashes; it is not a passing immutable CI revision.

Typed PostgreSQL arguments normalize lexical UUID spelling and integer input; a future HTTP DTO must preserve strict lexical validation. UTF-8/text excludes invalid UTF-8 and NUL. The exact reason is retained and capped at 1000 characters.
Encoder parity establishes canonical bytes only. Collection establishes import/discovery, not database semantics. All full migration/RLS/race/rollback assertions remain pending.
Source/preview/review/approval/new-claim/new-intent invalidation guards, truthful current-list behavior, authenticated persistence/recovery and complete archive enumeration remain incomplete.
Governance owns its final callable SQL admission and repair of immutable events bound to withdrawn evidence. Independent new capture does not provide that repair.

Company Archive owns the authoritative complete-withdrawal export fence. Registering this RF-owned table with the existing archive-generation protocol also remains required; it currently has no archive-generation trigger. Runtime withdrawal remains unavailable.
No complete withdrawal gap or A1/A2/A4 acceptance is closed; no production filing, current-law conformance or launch is authorized.
